verdict.rationale: Resend documents webhooks for real-time email events (opens, clicks, deliveries) and a dashboard that visualizes account activity, plus retrieval of links clicked in broadcasts, which together suggest event tracking exists. However, the evidence pack lacks an explicit per-message 'get email status/history' API endpoint that would let a developer query 'what happened to this email' by ID, and there is no independent confirmation of open/click tracking granularity or accuracy. Missing for 10: documented GET /emails/{id} (or similar) endpoint returning open/click event history, and independent/hands-on validation of open/click tracking accuracy.
